purpose: Choose defensible methodological decisions using authentic native pipelines and separately labelled geometric component ablations
claim_scope: Paired diagnostic comparison on the specified synthetic bank and independent analytical controls. No external clinical superiority or universal-best claim.

schedule.source: Existing M2 manifest and capture SHA256 locks

development.role: Adapter correctness, unit conventions and resource feasibility only. No comparator-specific quality tuning.
development.execution_policy: Pool24islocked, but one small predeclared development feasibility case plus independent analytical controls are mandatory before diagnostic execution. No full-development aggregate unless all24are actually scored for every registered method.

diagnostic.role: Predeclared paired diagnostic panel, all original test-patient groups retained.

schedule.render_backend_balance: Two torch-cached and two offline captures per patient, verified against manifest before execution
schedule.ordering: split, source_index, view, then method order alternated by patient index for shared-host timing
schedule.smoke: One known clean analytical case and one small development image may establish import, shape and timing. Record any wrapper changes and freeze before diagnostic inference.
schedule.optional_larger_panel: Any expansion to all112 or all64 is a separately labelled extension. Do not silently merge partial extension cases into the primary32 panel.
schedule.primary_execution: Complete32case diagnostic split only. All56querypanels remain frozen in the lock. Postprocessor --split test requires160case-method results and excludes incomplete development smoke prefixes from aggregate statistics.

tracks.input: Identical original RGB capture bytes or lossless PNG encoding, no gold nodes, IDs, layout windows or geometric reference passed to inference
tracks.output_requirement: Interpretable native source-pixel to physical-mm map, native eligible footprint, crop/resize/rotation chain, native scale/calibration assumptions and actual sampling status
tracks.unsupported_layouts: Report both all-layout operational performance and the predeclared stated-support stratum. A layout is not marked unsupported after seeing a failed prediction.

tracks.input: Same observed grid points and fixed IDs or four cell corners, with controlled physical coordinates supplied equally to every solver
tracks.stage_label: Component ablation, not authentic image-to-geometry performance and not commercial Dotter/Gridder
tracks.truth: Independent closed-form transformations evaluated at held-out interior/material queries, not at fitted corner nodes only

tracks.rule: Only if authentic pipeline and exact printed waveform windows are available. Native extraction results remain separate from pure rectification rankings. A changed extractor cannot certify a better rectifier.

availability_policy.npj: Official published-main implementation with Generic.yml as primary multilayout preset and GeorgeMoody2024.yml as a separately named predeclared original preset. Neither chosen using gold metrics. Ahus preset smoke only. Optional nonlinear TPS remains separate and is not substituted for published main.
availability_policy.kaggle: Run pinned original third-place pipeline and checkpoint. Any corrected half-pixel/NaN variant is a separately named adaptation, never silently substituted.
availability_policy.dotter_gridder: Actual commercial execution requires documented authorized access. A paper/patent-inspired primitive is not the commercial model. Unavailable commercial access is N/A, not failed inference.
availability_policy.new_auth_or_paid_access: Do not invent credentials or call undocumented endpoints. Record exact documented access requirement.

coordinate_contract.source_axes: x is column increasing right, y is row increasing down, original source pixel centres
coordinate_contract.physical_axes: Canonical paper x/y increasing according to the fixed renderer export convention. Adapter may apply a globally fixed documented row/column convention, never choose a sign/permutation per image from gold.
coordinate_contract.our_raw_map: Reconstruct from native inferred lattice IDs and the fixed5mm assumption, before any M2 evaluation-only D4/origin correction. Reuse of already gold-aligned M2 predicted maps as primary raw outputs is prohibited.
coordinate_contract.npj_raw_map: Compose exact native preprocessing, Hough/perspective, crop and rotation map, multiply each output axis by its native estimated mm-per-pixel. Its arbitrary cropped-image origin is not forced onto a5mm integer grid.
coordinate_contract.kaggle_raw_map: Compose exact stage0 orientation/homography and stage1 native grid warp, with the original declared nominal5mm major-grid pitch. Do not infer pitch by fitting gold. Preserve original interpolation and sampling conventions in the authentic arm.
coordinate_contract.backward_map_inversion: Only invert original valid nonfolded native cells with explicit boundary/overlap policy. Record holes, folds, overlaps and ambiguous inverse queries, never invent a dense forward map by free gold registration.
coordinate_contract.physical_scale: No gold-fitted scale, anisotropic rescaling, shear, affine transformation, smooth warp or nonuniform time rescaling is allowed.
coordinate_contract.primary_gauge: Continuous translation only. No per-image D4, rotation, reflection or axis permutation chosen from gold.
coordinate_contract.strict_native_origin: Where a method externally defines a physical origin, report raw native-origin errors separately. Translation-gauge results are not automatic absolute-origin or timing/baseline accuracy.
coordinate_contract.secondary_D4: Optional D4-plus-translation diagnostic reported in a separate table solely to distinguish orientation from shape/scale failure. Never used for primary ranking or winner selection.
coordinate_contract.M2_comparability: M3 numbers are not directly comparable with previous M2 aggregate G because the evaluation gauge changes and the case panel changes. Recompute all primary arms under the new common contract.

query_contract.reference: Original renderer-exported reference_mm and valid/material-support mask. The domain is selected independently of every method prediction.
query_contract.query_reuse: Reuse only existing M2 grid_query/grid_reference and paper_query/paper_reference arrays if their capture and domain hashes verify. Never reuse method predictions, eligibility, D4 or fitted offsets.
query_contract.query_measure: Uniform deterministic sampling of exported source-image material-support pixels, not a claim of uniform material area under perspective.
query_contract.visibility_audit: Independent QA reconstructed11post-noise opaque masks and checked112captures/224querydomains,1939checks PASS. Recorded opaque interiors are removed from valid, zero sampled queries in those interiors. Domain remains renderer-exported material support, not independent physical/camera metrology.
query_contract.domain_disclosure: Paper includes headers/margins/missing-grid regions within exported material support. Background is excluded. Physical occlusion status must be disclosed separately.

anchor_pool.domain: paper only, one pool shared by both scoring domains
anchor_pool.disjoint_from: Union of grid and paper scoring-query source positions
anchor_pool.selection: Without replacement from remaining eligible exported material-support source pixels, deterministic PCG64 RNG seeded by SHA256('20261023:'+case_key), using a recorded conversion of the first8digestbytes to an unsigned little-endian seed

translation_registration.eligible_anchor: Native eligible flag is true and predicted x/y are finite
translation_registration.predicted_span: Recorded only, not an eligibility gate. A collapsed or wrong-scale output must not escape W through an evaluation-only predicted-span rejection.
translation_registration.offset: Coordinatewise median(reference_mm minus native_predicted_mm) over every eligible anchor. No RANSAC, outlier removal or method-specific selection.
translation_registration.apply: Apply the same2Doffset to all grid and paper scoring predictions. Do not fit offsets separately by domain, lead, crop, connected component or query subset.
translation_registration.failure: Insufficient accepted finite anchors or insufficient reference span produces registration_unavailable. Keep the scheduled image and patient in denominators, show G=C=0 and undefined R with a distinct registration-failure flag. Do not drop or replace the case.
translation_registration.scope: Removes unidentifiable global chart-origin translation for geometry-shape comparison only. Not part of inference and not a claimed automatic origin estimate.

metrics.threshold_scope: Engineering comparison threshold, not a clinical acceptability criterion
metrics.G: Fixed-query fraction native-eligible, finite and physical error at most0.5mm after the permitted shared translation
metrics.W: Fixed-query fraction native-eligible and either nonfinite/invalid or physical error above0.5mm. Claimed-eligible NaN is wrong, not silently excluded.
metrics.C: Fixed-query fraction claimed eligible. G+W=C after explicit invalid-output accounting.
metrics.R: W/C recomputed from aggregate W and C, undefined at zero coverage
metrics.coverage_disclosure: All finite-error metrics are conditional on the finite returned subset. Report their counts and G/W/C alongside them, plus common-support paired error.
metrics.sampling_limit: An original archive proves retention of input bytes, not waveform preservation in the resampled image. A valid inverse or tiny roundtrip is not physical gold accuracy.

unrestricted_finite_field.footprint: Adapter explicitly supplies native_footprint to anchors/grid/paper. Never assume trusted eligibility equals actualRGBfootprint. No map extension beyond native crop.
unrestricted_finite_field.prediction: Finite physical coordinates inside actual footprint, confidence gate removed. Report nonfinite/fold/hole footprint counts separately. This diagnostic is not RGB waveform fidelity.
unrestricted_finite_field.registration: Reuse primary offset whenever available. If primary registration is unavailable, use one separately disclosed translation-only offset from finite-footprint anchors, reused for both domains. Do not mix this fallback with primary metrics.

operational_RGB_rectification.requirement: RGB actually resampled using the native map, not merely proposed full mesh or partial-coordinate output.
operational_RGB_rectification.failure_policy: For original-preserved, no-output, timeout or non-resampled cases, set operational G=C=0 and R undefined, retaining every scheduled case/patient. Keep native partial-coordinate metrics separately.
operational_RGB_rectification.success_metric: Where available, apply the actual-resampling gate to unrestricted finite physical-field metrics inside the native output footprint. Preserve inverse-validation holes/folds and claimed invalid counts.
operational_RGB_rectification.limit: An inverse-valid field can omit folded or ambiguous regions that native RGB still samples, especially in Kaggle. Report these cell counts and do not claim complete RGB fidelity from inverse-valid geometry alone.

failure_and_budget.root_memory_limit_note: 8GiBcgroup. Load and run large comparator models serially, use fresh subprocesses where feasible.
failure_and_budget.budget_change: Root may lower resolution/output budget for all comparable arms before diagnostic metrics. A method-specific budget adaptation receives a separate name and does not replace authentic-default results.
failure_and_budget.unavailable_vs_failed: Missing authenticated commercial access is not an attempted-case failure. Once a registered runnable method is scheduled, malformed/rejected/timeout inputs remain in its operational denominator.

aggregation.independent_unit: patient group, not image, lead or query
aggregation.overall: Mean within patient and backend, then equal weight for patients and the two backends
aggregation.all_layout_operational: All32 scheduled diagnostic cases, retaining out-of-supported-layout cases with their explicit statuses
aggregation.stated_support: Additional stratum determined from official method assumptions before inference. Report exact case and patient counts, no posthoc success-only subset.
aggregation.uncertainty: 20000 paired patient-cluster bootstrap draws, seed1973, preserve both backends and recalculate aggregate R. Descriptive conditional intervals only.
aggregation.superiority: No confirmatory SOTA claim from this already-inspected synthetic diagnostic panel. Report quality/coverage/latency Pareto decisions and severe individual failures. If later making formal multiple-comparator superiority claims, preregister a new independent assessment and multiplicity control.

analytic_component_minimum.grid_or_cells: Match observations/IDs/corners and material query positions across primitive solvers. Gold transform is independent of each fitted model and held-out queries are not corner constraints.
analytic_component_minimum.report: Every analytical scene and all arms retained. This diagnoses mechanisms and model bias, not clinical-population superiority.

decision_policy.retain: Original RGB, exact coordinate conventions, patient grouping, physical scale, explicit fallback, input-only budgets and independent gold queries
decision_policy.test_before_adopt: Grid organization/alias handling, global versus local geometry, affine versus projective versus bilinear cells, uncertainty/abstention, detector front-end resolution and sampling density
decision_policy.reject: Gold scale/shear rescue, best-case galleries only, NaNs dropped by nanmean, hidden fallback treated as successful dewarping, copied product names for an approximation, arbitrary mask erosion that wins only by coverage loss
decision_policy.new_method_selection: Use development and explicit analytic failure mechanisms. Any quality tuning after diagnostic results consumes this panel as development and requires a new independent assessment before a generalization claim.

execution_decision.our_detector: Rerun frozen checkpoint threshold0.85 and periodic-banding pipeline once per capture, no new training. B0/M2 share these M3 detections. M2 cached detections are replay diagnostics only, not current timing.
execution_decision.execution: Models loaded once, inference serial CPU2threads, method order alternated by patient. CNN output reuse between npj presets requires proven exact equivalence and separate stage timing disclosure.
execution_decision.models: No case expansion beyond32diagnostic and24development without separately labelled extension.
